mentions.name: Arabic-language Electronic Health Records system
mentions.description: An Arabic-language Electronic Health Records system built with Elixir, Ash, Phoenix, LiveView and Bootstrap, intended to be marketed to clinics in Syria; currently closed-source with no plans to release as free/open-source.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an Arabic-language Electronic Health Records system (moving to Syria in about 2 months and planning to market to clinics there). No current plans to release as Free/Open-Source, but the stack is Elixir/Ash/Phoenix/LiveView/Bootstrap.
